recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no source follow-up is needed for FHIR-43647 unless a future work-group decision changes the intended meaning of ActorDefinition.documentation.
issue_request: FHIR-43647 asked to clarify ActorDefinition.documentation because the old short text, "Functionality associated with the actor", did not explain what functionality was intended. The Applied/Persuasive resolution required the short text "Explanation and details about the actor" and the definition "Details describing the nature of the actor as well as boundaries that distinguish this type of actor from other actors."

additional_context: source/fhir.ini includes an active actordefinition resource entry and marks ActorDefinition normative, so the inspected StructureDefinition is current build input. A later same-element issue, FHIR-44477, changed only the adjacent comment and preserved the FHIR-43647 short and definition. Confluence FHIR-I WGM 202401 minutes record the FHIR-43647 Persuasive vote, and Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting thread.
